title: CallSo
description: Till date everyone in web2 & web3 space resort on their email address or phone number to connect with a communication platform or between each other like discord, telegram and others. CallSo changes the narrative to connect, communicate and engagement among its users using crypto wallets, domains or Nfts to voice call, video call and message. We tend to provide a censorship free application for users of web3 to communicate, keeping user and its data private to themselves.
how_its_made: We ran into several challenges while integerating product APIs. We faced a major issue in integerating push chat and notification which was seen unresolved by even the push team, we ran into problem of revere resoultion of ENS in the platform which we solved using Quick Node.
